hysterectomy with the placenta left in situ
cohort: Pregnant women with placenta previa accreta/increta/percreta undergoing cesarean hysterectomy
finding: This abstract discusses the surgical techniques and considerations for minimizing complications during cesarean hysterectomy in cases of placenta previa accreta/increta/percreta.
